films.title: True Lies
credits: Cast – Alex Boulin, Alizee Lamur & Matthieu Serrano
synopsis: In a world of lies, Julie takes her boyfriend Anthony to a specialist. Her last hope to cure him of the strange ailment tormenting him: he has stopped lying.

films.title: The Box
synopsis: Two police officers must lie in wait to ambush their target, however their mission isn’t exactly what it seems.

films.title: Just Be Awesome
credits: Cast – Spencer Jones, Alice Lowe, Hatty Preston +
synopsis: With spiralling debts and a partner at the end of her tether, Alex desperately needs work. An opportunity at an absurdly trendy agency offers a way out. But he’s going to have to play their game if he wants to land the role.

films.title: The Punt
credits: Cast – Carole Patullo, Sidney Sylvester Smith & Jese Tuivoavoa
synopsis: In a desolate dive bar, a seemingly mundane encounter between a weary patron and a desperate intruder takes a philosophical turn.

films.title: The Sandwich
credits: Cast – Jonathan Wier, Rory Mcdonagh, Jan Mckay +
synopsis: A stolen sandwich turns Austin into the office’s most dangerous man.

films.title: Gourmade
synopsis: When a late-night emotional eater tries out the latest health craze, a revolutionary smart oven called ‘Gourmade’, she’ll soon find out that delicious meals aren’t the only things this AI oven is dishing out!

films.title: Stranded
synopsis: When Kelly dumps Brian, his world comes crashing down, again. Just like when their cruise ship sank, leaving them as the only two survivors stranded on a deserted island…

films.title: Open 2 Offers
credits: Cast – Chad Richards, Anna James, Niall Connon-Jackson +
synopsis: At ANY cost. Young couple Steven & Tracey learn this the hard way as they discover when you die is nowhere near as important as WHERE…

films.title: NFIS
credits: Co-directors & Co-writers – Tom Pasley & Trent Ivett
Cast – Dave Fraser, Tia Faulkner & Gus Pasley
synopsis: A grizzled detective follows his hunch all the way to the end to get his sweet reward…

films.title: I Owe You One
synopsis: Raúl and Lucas have been friends their whole lives. One day, Raúl is driving Lucas home… but first, he asks him for a favour. An important one. After all, Lucas owes him.

films.title: Gramps
credits: Cast – Brynn E. Berg & Timothy Fannon
synopsis: Carol wanted to meet her boyfriend in an abandoned house up the road, but instead, she encounters the not-so-urban legend, Old Gramps, a dusty zombie with an appetite for flesh and no sense of humour.

films.title: Miracle of Christmas
synopsis: On Christmas Eve, Atte, a family man failed at life, has decided to end it all. However, an unexpected visitor arrives, bringing him a Christmas surprise.

films.title: Game Over
credits: Cast – Jean-Yves Lissonet, Lynne Verall & Adrian Rawlins
synopsis: Sunday is Scrabble day for an elderly couple. The sunny scene opens with the old man’s hateful inner monologue as he is forced to take part in the game.

films.title: Country Roads
credits: Cast – Pete Collie, Grace Glen-Wales & Jon Payne
synopsis: A couple encounters a body lying in the middle of a country road, facing them with the ultimate conundrum of what to do next.
